---
title: "Run the workflow"
---


Run commands from the repository root, the folder containing this file and `scripts/`. Complete the R environment setup in the practice opening page first.

The analysis script checks the three input tables before calculating results. It also compares the direct Shannon formula with vegan for every sample.

Choose the command for the dataset you are working with.

| Stage | Input folder | Output folder |
|---|---|---|
| Practice | `data/example/` | `results/example/` |
| DietSwap | `data/dietswap/` | `results/dietswap/` |
| GlobalPatterns | `data/global-patterns/` | `results/global-patterns/` |
| Your analysis | `data/my-study/` | `results/my-study/` |

### Practice

```bash
Rscript scripts/R/02-analyse-example.R data/example results/example
```

### DietSwap

Place all three prepared study tables in the input folder first.

```bash
Rscript scripts/R/02-analyse-example.R data/dietswap results/dietswap
```

### GlobalPatterns

```bash
Rscript scripts/R/02-analyse-example.R data/global-patterns results/global-patterns
```

### Your analysis

```bash
Rscript scripts/R/02-analyse-example.R data/my-study results/my-study
```

### Independently verify one sample

For practice, run:

```bash
Rscript scripts/R/05-verify-sample.R data/example results/example A01
```

For DietSwap or your own analysis, replace both folder paths and A01 with your selected sample ID. All three rows should show TRUE under `agrees`.

### Find the outputs

Each output folder contains `figures/`, `tables/`, and `session-info.txt`. Open `tables/alpha-diversity.tsv` to check counts, observed features, and Shannon values.

The analysis writes to the selected output folder on each run. Use a new output folder to preserve an earlier analysis. Stop after an error and resolve it before interpreting existing outputs.
